source.title: SAMPLE COSTS TO PRODUCE
source.counties: Brenna Aegerter UC Cooperative Extension Farm Advisor, San Joaquin
source.publisher: UC Davis Department of Agricultural and Resource Economics / UC Cooperative Extension

priceYear.quote: Sample costs for labor, materials, equipment, and custom services are based on current figures. (Current at the time of the study, so the study year 2014 is used.)

acresFarmed.quote: The hypothetical field and row-crop farm consists of 3,500 non-contiguous acres of rented land at 12% of gross tomato revenue for this budget.

acresCrop.quote: Tomatoes are transplanted on 1,000 acres (700 acres are sub- surface drip irrigated and 300 acres are furrow irrigated).

laborMachineRate.quote: Adding 36% for the employer’s share of federal and state payroll taxes, insurance and other benefits raises the total labor costs to $17.00 per hour for machine operators and $13.60 per hour for non-machine laborers.

laborNonMachineRate.quote: Adding 36% for the employer’s share of federal and state payroll taxes, insurance and other benefits raises the total labor costs to $17.00 per hour for machine operators and $13.60 per hour for non-machine laborers.

fuelPriceDiesel.quote: Prices for on-farm delivery of diesel and unleaded gasoline are $4.12 and $3.93 per gallon, respectively.

fuelPriceGas.quote: Prices for on-farm delivery of diesel and unleaded gasoline are $4.12 and $3.93 per gallon, respectively.

yieldStatement.quote: In this study, a yield of 44 tons per acre is used to reflect higher yields under drip irrigation.

priceStatement.quote: A price of $80.00 per ton is used in this study.

costsPerAcre.title: COSTS PER ACRE TO PRODUCE PROCESS TOMATOES (SDI)

capitalRecoveryFormula.quote: [{Purchase Price - Salvage Value} x Capital Recovery Factor] + [Salvage Value x Interest Rate]

salvageMethod.quote: Salvage value is an estimate of the remaining value of an investment at the end of its useful life.

machineLaborFactor.quote: The labor for operations involving machinery is 20% higher than the field operation time to account for equipment set up, road travel, maintenance, and repair.

monthly.quote: MONTHLY COSTS PER ACRE TO PRODUCE PROCESS TOMATOES (SDI)
